1879191224.name: Lend Resolve
1879191224.desc: Your Herald encourages you in times of battle, raising your Morale and Power at the cost of their own.

1879222200.name: Precise Map to Glân Vraig
1879222200.desc: A good map allowing you travel to Glân Vraig, the base of the Free Peoples in the Ettenmoors.

1879227832.name: Ring of Fire
1879227832.desc: Harness the power of Fire to provide a powerful offensive boon to an ally without a ring.

1879244344.name: Improved Steadfast Barrage
1879244344.desc: You focus all of your ranged fire on a single opponent.  Barraging attacks cannot critical and they cannot miss, be blocked, evaded, or parried.

1879244856.name: Discipline: Rohirrim
1879244856.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff>Rohirrim</rgb>

The Rohirrim Discipline focuses on the Warden's ability to lead his War-steed at the head of a mounted conflict; enhancing his ability to survive against overwhelming odds.

1879245368.name: Toxic Carapace
1879245368.desc:
Corruption:
A venomous secretion coats your carapace, protecting you and causing damage to attackers.

<rgb=#00ff00>Consumes all Venom.
For each Venom consumed, you receive another tier of the effect, extending the duration and increasing its initial potency.</rgb>

1879245624.name: Resolution
1879245624.desc:
<rgb=#66ffff>In Rohirrim</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>All things end, and sometimes the resolution brings great succor.</rgb>

<rgb=#66ffff>In Riddermark</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>All things end, and once resolved one can find they have been dumbfounded.</rgb>

<rgb=#66ffff>In Red Dawn</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>All things end, and when fire is involved all that remains is ash and ruin.</rgb>

1879247800.name: Sundering Blow
1879247800.desc: A violent attack dealing good damage to a target. Critical strikes cause enhanced effects.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879254072.name: Strategic Strike
1879254072.desc: Enhanced damage when striking the target from behind. The Burglar targets a vital location and deals a significant amount of damage to their target.

1879269944.name: Command Pet
1879269944.desc: You signal towards the enemy, sending your companion off to attack.

1879271864.name: Standard of Honour
1879271864.desc: Calls forth the Standard of Honour, dealing damage to enemies while healing the Morale of nearby allies.
